name: Customer Service / Help
explanation: Amazon's built-in help app. Settings and online support still work without it.

name: Legal Notices
explanation: Displays legal text only. Nothing else depends on it.

name: Amazon GameCircle
explanation: Old game leaderboard service that most apps no longer use.

name: Freevee (IMDb TV)
explanation: Free ad-supported streaming app. Removing it hides it from the home screen.

name: Amazon Music
explanation: Removing it means you can't play Amazon Music on this TV.

name: Amazon Games
explanation: Game store tile. Installed games from other stores are unaffected.

name: Screensaver
explanation: The idle-screen slideshow and ads. You'll get a plain dim screen instead.
